blocks.description: A tape with three numbered entries: output, file and clock, joined by arrows. Below, the note that they are chained and that replaying gives the same run.

caption.text: Every effect is noted on the tape with its number, its task and its result. Replaying the tape gives the same run without asking the host.

points.text: A failing statement leaves no half-done effects.
Every effect is requested, resolved and noted on the tape.
The tape allows replaying the run exactly.
